requirements.description: Add search filters allowing users to narrow results by category and city
requirements.quote: I want them to narrow it down by category and by city.

requirements.description: Streamline the member addition process to reduce manual admin effort
requirements.quote: Adding members. Right now I add every new business by hand from the admin, about thirty a week. It takes hours.

requirements.description: Implement a monthly newsletter that is sent only to members who have opted in
requirements.quote: I want to send a newsletter to all members once a month.

requirements.description: Fix the mobile homepage layout so the menu does not overlap the logo and looks good on phones
requirements.quote: The homepage looks terrible on phones. The menu overlaps the logo.

constraints.quote: I would like it done by the end of November.
